text: {"question":"Which generalized PAge parameterization is most strongly favored when the FAP data are included, and how does its preference compare to the other GPAge models?","reference_answer":"When the FAP data are added, the TGPAge‑Fix model is strongly preferred over the SGPAge model, and TGPAge‑Free is not significantly better (and can even be worse) than TGPAge‑Fix.","passage_1_contribution":"Passage A states that GPAge parameterizations can alleviate the Hubble tension and are preferred over ΛCDM.","passage_2_contribution":"Passage B provides the evidence that, with FAP data, TGPAge‑Fix and TGPAge‑Free are strongly favored over SGPAge, and TGPAge‑Free is not much better than TGPAge‑Fix.","joint_reason":"The claim in A about the superiority of GPAge models is substantiated by the quantitative comparison in B, which specifies the relative preference among the GPAge variants.","same_quantity":true}
